messages:
maria_g: Heads-up: planning a TF apply during tonight's quiet window (02:00 UTC). This is the litmus provider upgrade + small IAM drift fix. Requesting a single approver and one runner.

josh_w: LGTM on the plan. Who's running? I can take the runner if no objections.

carla_ops: :eyes: Can we pin provider to 3.4.1 before apply? last time 3.5 caused drift. Also add provider_lock in module root.

maria_g: Yes, will pin to `hashicorp/provider@3.4.1` in the module. Patch PR is #4123.

ben_p: Add the rollback step in runbook: `terraform state rollback <backup>` isn't safe. We'll snapshot state and have untouched backup S3 path. I'll add the commands.

maria_g: Runbook excerpt ->
```bash
tfstate_backup=$(date +%s)-preapply.tfstate
aws s3 cp s3://infra-backups/current.tfstate s3://infra-backups/$tfstate_backup
# then terraform apply -auto-approve
```

deploybot: Scheduled: apply queued for 2025-11-02T02:00:00Z on `prod` with lock TTL=30m. If `sre_oncall` sets `hold`, deployment will pause.

sre_oncall: I'll be on-call. Please ping if preflight errors. If any SLO alert during apply I will hit hold.

josh_w: Two quick asks: 1) canary on iam create only for a single tenant via `-target=module.tenant["litmus"]`? 2) plan output attachment?

carla_ops: Yes to targeted apply. I can post plan in the channel once I've run `terraform plan -target=... -out=plan.litmus`

maria_g: Thanks all. Approver check: anyone object? Otherwise i approve — :thumbsup:

ben_p: :thumbsup: from me. Maria, ping when you start so I can tail rollback metrics.

sre_oncall: No objections. I'll be monitoring. good luck.

deploybot: Action: apply started by josh_w at 2025-11-02T02:00:05Z. Logs -> https://deploys/redwood/1767894320

josh_w: Starting now. will post plan and short summary after `apply`.
